Report title: Mortality in State and Federal Prisons, 2001-2018 – Statistical Tables  NCJ 255970
Data source: Bureau of Justice Statistics, Mortality in Correctional Institutions, 2001–2018; and Federal Bureau of Prisons, 2001–2018
Author: E. Ann Carson, Ph.D., BJS Statistician
Figure 1. Number of state and federal prisoner deaths, 2001–2018
a/Excludes deaths in private federal facilities.
b/Includes deaths due to illnesses, such as heart disease, cancer, liver disease, and AIDS-related deaths.
c/Includes deaths due to external factors and causes, such as suicide, homicide, and accidental deaths.
Source: Bureau of Justice Statistics, Mortality in Correctional Institutions, 2001–2018; and Federal Bureau of Prisons, 2001–2018.
